```sql
WITH
  customer_addresses AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
    FROM customer_address ca
    WHERE ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
  ),
  customer_demographics_with_sales AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk, cd.*
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND ss.d_year = 2002 AND ss.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
    WHERE ss.ss_customer_sk IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND ws.d_year = 2002 AND ws.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2 WHERE ws.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND cs.d_year = 2002 AND cs.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2 WHERE cs.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL
  ),
  sales_counts AS (
    SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) cnt3
    FROM customer_demographics_with_sales
    GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
  )
SELECT *
FROM sales_counts
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100;
```

This query uses CTEs (Common Table Expressions) to break down the complex subqueries and joins into smaller, more manageable parts. This should help improve performance by reducing the number of times the database needs to scan tables and perform joins.
